description: Defines the DashletRssFeedTitle class, which parses and generates a title from an RSS feed URL, handling encoding and truncation.

classes.name: DashletRssFeedTitle
classes.description: A class for parsing RSS feed titles from a URL, extracting the title, managing encoding, and shortening the title if necessary.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with the given RSS feed URL.

methods.name: generateTitle
methods.description: Reads the feed, extracts and processes the title, returning the final title string.

methods.name: readFeed
methods.description: Fetches content from the RSS feed URL if it uses HTTP or HTTPS scheme.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Extracts the title from the feed content using a regex pattern, sanitizes it.

methods.name: cutLength
methods.description: Shortens the title to the specified length if it exceeds it, appending an ellipsis.

methods.name: _identifyXmlEncoding
methods.description: Detects the encoding specified in the XML feed content.

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Converts the title's encoding to UTF-8 based on the detected XML encoding.
